title: Deleting a board-only worktree from the list asks first when its board edits never reached GitHub
notes:
Follow-up to #393 (ship-decision-7). The sweeps now keep a worktree whose board edits are not on origin's default branch (boardNotOnOrigin in src/main/ship/board-on-origin.ts), but pressing d on a board-only worktree in the worktree list still force-removes it without asking. Example: a card edit made in a worktree while offline is gone after one keypress.

Do: when d targets a worktree for which boardNotOnOrigin finds files, ask first (a confirm row the arrow keys walk, per conventions-rule-1) naming the files; a failed fetch counts as not on origin. A worktree whose board edits are all on origin is removed as today. The refusal's predicate is the one the sweeps use (errors-rule-1), with a decision test, and the help blurb and docs updated.
